translations.web: “Also, Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, when I restore the fortunes of my people.
translations.bsb: Also for you, O Judah, a harvest is appointed, when I restore My people from captivity.
translations.kjv: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.
